Woven-branch huts and hollow-log dwellings lean together over the ravine, lashed with vines, bark-moss walls bristling with ferns, toadstool platforms stacked below, soft amber light filtering through every woven gap.

Mushroom-cap houses and giant blooming flower homes crowd the boulder slopes, petals and caps side by side in cheerful disarray, gourd lanterns swinging at each door, warm glowing windows at every turn.
Pumpkin homes and bark-slab cottages hug the curved roots of the great fallen tree, orange walls carved with tiny windows, moss packed into every gap, root-woven fences marking each cozy courtyard.

Toadstool turrets and woven-reed cottages rise from the boggy island, each one leaning at a different happy angle, soft light glowing from tightly woven walls, gourd-roofed porches hanging over still dark water.

Hollow-log homes and walnut-shell roofed cottages are wedged into the canyon ledges, bark chimneys puffing, root-lace walls binding each dwelling to the stone, warm window-glow striping the shadowed cliff face orange.

Giant flower-cup dwellings and mushroom-cap houses nestle into the gnarled hedgerow, petals curled into walls, caps tipped like hats, bark-moss paths winding between each softly glowing petal-framed window.

Gourd-houses and seed-pod cottages dangle from the cliff-edge roots, swaying in the breeze, woven-branch platforms steadying each one, warm amber light glowing from every rounded belly and tapered tip.

Bark-and-moss cottages and living-trunk homes grow directly from the ancient hillside trees, roots becoming floors, bark becoming walls, toadstool rooftops layered above, cozy windows glowing gold through curtains of hanging moss.

Acorn-cap roofed burrows and woven-branch nests cover the old stone wall in a cheerful scramble, root-woven ladders connecting each level, pumpkin-lantern doorways glowing warmly, moss stuffed into every chink and gap.

Mushroom-cap houses and hollow gourd dwellings crowd the base of the waterfall cliff, toadstool turrets misted with spray, bark-slab walls dark and damp, warm windows glowing bravely through the perpetual silver haze.
